name: Respect
overview: Scripture teaches that respect is a vital expression of godly living, demonstrated through honoring parents and the elderly as commanded in Exodus 20:12 and Leviticus 19:32. Respect extends to social relationships, urging humility before those in authority or honor, such as rulers or hosts, as seen in Proverbs 25:6 and Luke 14:10. The principle of treating others as we wish to be treated (Matthew 7:12) and preferring one another in brotherly love (Romans 12:10) underscores respect as an active, Christ-centered attitude toward all people.
